finalText:
I've rebooked all 13 reservations from cancelled AA918 under the irregular-operations rules. Nobody paid a change fee or fare difference, and nobody was moved to a lower cabin. I issued the compensation and hotel vouchers owed and messaged each passenger once with their new itinerary.

There were no bulletins in effect and nothing on the ledger beforehand. No one's tier had changed, so I used current tiers.

**Something to check:** today's system date is 2026-10-06, two months after the 2026-08-03 flight date. I did what the task asked, but the new itineraries and vouchers are for dates that have already passed. Operations may want to confirm the records are meant to be backdated like this.

The table is in priority order: platinum, then gold, silver and no tier, earliest booking first within each tier. AA918 was due into Chicago O'Hare (ORD) at 13:40.

| Reservation | Passenger (tier) | New itinerary | Cabin | Vouchers |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| R6103 | Chloe Park (platinum) | UA88, 06:15–12:25 | Business | None (arrives early) |
| R6109 | Iris Vance (platinum) | UA88, 06:15–12:25 | Premium economy (upgraded from economy) | None |
| R6110 + R6111 (group) | Jun Takeda / Kofi Mensah (gold) | AA204, 09:05–15:15, together | Economy | None (1h35m late) |
| R6102 | Ben Okafor (gold) | DL512, 12:30–18:40 | Economy | $150 compensation (5h late) |
| R6106 | Farid Haddad (gold) | UA88, 06:15–12:25 | Basic economy | None |
| R6112 | Lea Sorensen (gold) | AA204, 09:05–15:15 | Business (upgraded from premium economy) | None |
| R6104 | Dev Mehta (silver) | AA210 SFO–ORD 17:40–23:50, then AA1410 ORD–BOS on 08-04, 09:00–12:25 | Economy | $300 compensation + $180 hotel |
| R6113 | Mo Farah (silver) | Same as Dev Mehta | Economy | $300 compensation + $180 hotel |
| R6108 | Hugo Brandt (silver) | AA210, 17:40–23:50 | Economy | $300 compensation (10h10m late) |
| R6107 | Grace Liu (none) | AA206 on 08-04, 09:05–15:15 | Economy | $240 compensation (capped at her $240 fare) + $180 hotel |
| R6101 | Ana Ruiz (none) | AA206 on 08-04, 09:05–15:15 | Economy | $300 compensation + $180 hotel |
| R6105 | Elena Fox (none) | AA204, 09:05–15:15 | Basic economy | None (1h35m late) |

- **Upgrades:** Iris and Lea were the only ones moved up, one cabin each. Both are platinum or gold and travelling alone. Their own cabin was full on a flight that gets in sooner than anything still open in that cabin.
- **No upgrade for Ben:** there was no seat one cabin up on any earlier flight, so he went to the first open economy seat on DL512.
- **Jun and Kofi:** they kept their own cabin and the gold priority of the higher-tier member. They were not split or upgraded.
- **Boston connections:** Dev's and Mo's original 15:30 flight to Boston can't be reached anymore. Every economy seat into Chicago before AA210 was taken, and there are no later flights to Boston that evening, so the overnight connection is the soonest arrival.
- **Next-day passengers:** Grace and Ana are on 08-04 because every economy seat on 08-03 was gone by the time their turn came.
